project_type: Turborepo monorepo (npm workspaces): apps/api (Fastify + Prisma backend), packages/db (Prisma schema + clients + withTenant), packages/shared (catalogues + zod), plus apps/web.
language: TypeScript (NodeNext ESM). Import specifiers between local .ts files use the .js extension.
build_system: npm workspaces + Turborepo. Root: `npm run build` runs `turbo build`. API: `cd apps/api && npm run build` = `prisma generate --schema=../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc`. Node >=20. Package manager npm@11.6.2.
test_framework: Vitest 4 (globals enabled). apps/api/vitest.config.ts include = ['src/**/*.test.ts', 'src/**/*.property.test.ts']; *.integration.test.ts matches *.test.ts so it runs. Mocked suites mock @campusgate/db; the *.integration.test.ts suites hit LIVE Supabase.
build_command: npm run build  (root, Turborepo). Also: cd apps/api && npm run build.
test_command: cd apps/api && npx vitest run   (runs all 142 current tests incl. live-DB integration suites).
verification_instructions: 1) From packages/db apply the new migration: `cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate dev --name superadmin_security` (DDL runs as postgres via DIRECT_URL against live Supabase), then `npx prisma generate`. 2) Root `npm run build` must pass. 3) `cd apps/api && npx vitest run` must keep ALL 142 baseline tests green plus the new tests. 4) REQUIRED live smoke: build then `node apps/api/dist/server.js` against Supabase and confirm startup + a grant create/access/accessed audit round-trip. Integration suites require apps/api/.env (campass_app, 6543) and packages/db/.env (DIRECT_URL postgres, 5432).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated (not committed) by `prisma generate` during build. A new migration directory packages/db/prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_superadmin_security/migration.sql is created and committed. No other generated-but-committed files.
environment_constraints: Work on `main`, NO worktree. Do NOT push or deploy. Never commit .env (apps/api/.env, packages/db/.env hold live Supabase secrets). B-1 (20261018110658_tenancy_isolation_rls) and identity_rbac_b2 (20261018171747_identity_rbac_b2) migration SQL are FROZEN — never edit; add a NEW migration only. campass_app must NEVER be granted BYPASSRLS. Commit specific files only; clean up temp scripts. Windows/PowerShell host.
contribution_requirements: Keep the app building and runnable at every feature boundary. Preserve live tenancy (withTenant/RLS) + RBAC (authz engine requirePermission/can/requireModuleActive), the Phase-0 compatibility shim, and the legacy `role` JWT claim. New tenant-readable tables follow the tenancy checklist + escape-suite coverage. Reuse the existing authz engine + shared catalogues; add exactly one new permission key (admin.support.revoke). Do NOT build module entitlement/activation or any section 9 deferred item.
key_patterns: Hand-authored migrations with ordered sections, DO $$ RLS blocks, and a guarded `IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='campass_app')` GRANT refresh at the end (see the two existing migrations). RLS policies use current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true); new policies wrap it in nullif(..., '') to fail-closed on empty-string. Audit writes happen INSIDE the tenant withTenant tx (campass_app has INSERT on audit_events; UPDATE/DELETE revoked). privilegedPrisma = postgres role (BYPASSRLS) for platform/pre-tenant/cross-tenant. request.auth is populated once by the top-level authenticate hook; handlers read userId/roles[0]/membershipId/institutionId from it (legacy request.user.role is the role-snapshot fallback). The catalogue-sync meta-test statically parses migration SQL seed blocks delimited by `INSERT INTO "permissions"`...`ON CONFLICT` and `INSERT INTO "role_permissions"`...`AS m(`.
